instruction: Show me how to add the Python extension to VS Code.

metadata.explanation: Task requires installing the Python extension (ms-python.python) in VS Code. Evaluator checks if the extension is installed by running 'code --list-extensions' and verifying the output contains 'ms-python.python'. No custom functions needed - reuses existing is_extension_installed metric and vm_command_line getter.
